prompt: You operate a Google Sheets spreadsheet. READING: Google Sheets renders the grid to a CANVAS, so the DOM is empty — do NOT try to read the grid via DOM/snapshot. Read with sheets.read, which fetches the sheet's own /htmlview/sheet HTML view (page.fetch, same-origin) and returns the grid as rows of cells. Pass sheet_id = the URL segment after /spreadsheets/d/, and gid = the numeric grid id from the URL (#gid=<gid>, or gid=0 for the first tab). WRITING a single cell: type its reference into the Name Box (top-left, above the grid), press Enter to select it, type the value, press Enter to commit (sheets.cell.set does this). WRITING a block: first click the top-left anchor cell on the grid CANVAS so the grid itself has focus, then call sheets.range.paste_tsv { tsv }. Do NOT use the Name Box as the range-paste anchor path: it steals focus and the paste can report default_prevented:false or land wrong. sheets.range.paste_tsv does not accept anchor_ref and does not select the anchor for you. Never navigate or reload while a cell edit is open. VERIFY writes with sheets.read after a brief settle (the htmlview is regenerated server-side and can lag a second or two).
skill: Call sheets.map first. sheets.read is a page.fetch workflow (canvas DOM is blind) — mirrors the VALIDATED docs.read pattern. sheet_id = URL segment after /spreadsheets/d/; gid = the #gid=<n> in the URL (first tab is 0). The read parses Google's own <table class='waffle'> htmlview: each <tbody> <tr> is a row (leading <th> is the row-header number), each <td> is a cell. NOTE: the cell parser is tag-naive — it returns each cell's plain text; a cell containing rich HTML (links, nested spans) may read partially. Plain values (the CRM case) read cleanly. VALIDATION STATUS (2026-07-05, all screenshot-confirmed live): sheets.read VALIDATED including MULTI-COLUMN (returns distinct cells per <td>); sheets.range.paste_tsv VALIDATED (a 3x3 TSV expanded into a real A:C range, numbers stayed numeric, Sheets summed them). CRITICAL WRITE RULE: for range paste, click the anchor cell on the grid CANVAS to focus the grid, then paste — the Name Box + Enter path steals focus and the paste misfires (default_prevented:false vs true). sheets.cell.set uses the Name Box flow and needs the tab foregrounded; its canvas selection repaints async.
notes:
Read endpoint: page.fetch https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d//htmlview/sheet?headers=true&gid=. The TOP /htmlview is a JS shell — the sheet sub-path returns the real grid as . Parser isolates the table between '
', splits rows on ' row-header). Name Box selector on modern Sheets: input.waffle-name-box, or the box showing the active-cell ref at the grid's top-left. Single-cell writes can use the Name Box flow. TSV range paste must not: focus the anchor cell on the grid canvas, then clipboard.paste a string with \t between columns and \n between rows; Sheets expands it into a range starting at the focused grid cell.

tools.name: sheets.map
tools.description: Return operating guidance for the Google Sheets spreadsheet map. Call this FIRST, before any other sheets action.

static_output.read: sheets.read { sheet_id, gid } — fetches the sheet's /htmlview/sheet HTML (page.fetch, same-origin) and returns { title, rows } where rows is an array of cell-arrays. The grid DOM is canvas-rendered and blind; ALWAYS read this way. sheet_id = URL segment after /spreadsheets/d/; gid = the #gid=<n> in the URL (first tab = 0).
static_output.write_cell: sheets.cell.set { cell_ref, value } — types cell_ref into the Name Box, Enter to select, types value, Enter to commit. Needs the tab foregrounded.
static_output.write_block: sheets.range.paste_tsv { tsv } — paste a TSV block (\t between columns, \n between rows) into the currently focused grid cell; Sheets expands it into a range. Precondition: click the top-left anchor cell on the grid canvas first. Do not pass anchor_ref; this action does not select the anchor and the Name Box path is invalid for range paste.
static_output.verify: After a write, wait ~1-2s (htmlview regenerates server-side) then sheets.read to confirm.
recommended_sequence: sheets.cell.set { cell_ref, value } — set one cell
click the grid canvas top-left anchor cell, then sheets.range.paste_tsv { tsv } — set a block

tools.name: sheets.read
tools.description: Read the current Google Sheets grid as structured rows. Google Sheets paints the grid to a canvas, so the DOM is blind; this fetches the sheet's own same-origin /htmlview/sheet HTML view and parses the <table class='waffle'> into rows of cells. Pass sheet_id = the URL segment after /spreadsheets/d/ (e.g. from https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/ABC123/edit#gid=0, sheet_id is ABC123), and gid = the numeric grid id (the #gid=<n>; first tab is 0). Returns { title, rows } where rows is an array of arrays of cell text. Use before editing and to verify writes.

sheet_id.description: The spreadsheet id from the tab URL (segment after /spreadsheets/d/).

gid.description: The numeric grid id of the sheet tab (the #gid=<n> in the URL; the first tab is 0).

workflow.output: {% ( $b := steps.fetchSheet.output.body; $title := $substringBefore($substringAfter($b, 'og:title" content="'), '"'); $table := $substringBefore($substringAfter($b, ''); $body := $substringAfter($table, ''); $rowFrags := [$filter($split($body, ' 0 })]; $rows := [$map($rowFrags, function($rf) { ( $cellFrags := [$filter($split($rf, ' 0 })]; [$map($cellFrags, function($cf) { $trim($replace($substringBefore($substringAfter($cf, '>'), ''), /<[^>]*>/, '')) })] ) })]; { 'title': $title, 'rows': $rows, 'row_count': $count($rows), 'fetch_status': steps.fetchSheet.output.status } ) %}

tools.name: sheets.range.paste_tsv
tools.description: Paste a TSV block at the currently focused grid anchor. PRECONDITION: click the exact anchor cell on the grid canvas first. Pass that same identity as anchor_cell; the workflow reads htmlview before and after and verifies the complete rectangular region at that coordinate. Independently confirm with sheets.read.

anchor_cell.description: A1 identity of the grid cell already focused by the caller.

tsv.description: The block to paste: TAB (\t) between columns, NEWLINE (\n) between rows. Expands into a range from the selected anchor cell.

workflow.output: {% ( $parse := function($b) { ( $table := $substringBefore($substringAfter($b, ''); $body := $substringAfter($table, ''); $rowFrags := [$filter($split($body, ' 0 })]; [$map($rowFrags, function($rf) { ( $cellFrags := [$filter($split($rf, ' 0 })]; [$map($cellFrags, function($cf) { $trim($replace($substringBefore($substringAfter($cf, '>'), ''), /<[^>]*>/, '')) })] ) })] ) }; $coord := $uppercase(input.anchor_cell); $letters := $replace($coord, /[0-9]+/, ''); $row := $number($replace($coord, /[A-Z]+/, '')) - 1; $col := $reduce($split($letters, ''), function($a, $c) { $a * 26 + $length($substringBefore('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ', $c)) + 1 }, 0) - 1; $expected := [$map($split(input.tsv, '\n'), function($r) { [$split($r, '\t')] })]; $beforeRows := $parse(steps.fetchBefore.output.body); $afterRows := $parse(steps.verifyFetch.output.body); $region := function($rows) { [$map($expected, function($er, $ri) { [$map($er, function($v, $ci) { ($targetRow := $rows[$row + $ri]; $targetRow[$col + $ci]) })] })] }; $before := $region($beforeRows); $after := $region($afterRows); $verified := steps.paste.output.default_prevented and $string($after) = $string($expected) and $string($before) != $string($expected); { 'anchor_cell': $coord, 'accepted': steps.paste.output.default_prevented, 'expected_region': $expected, 'before_region': $before, 'after_region': $after, 'verified': $verified, 'fetch_status': steps.verifyFetch.output.status, 'next_step': $verified ? 'Range verified at the exact anchor through htmlview; independently confirm with sheets.read.' : 'Range did not verify at the exact anchor. Do not claim success; re-read the sheet and restore grid focus.' } ) %}

tools.name: sheets.range.paste_tsv_at_anchor
tools.description: Attempt to select an exact anchor through the Name Box and paste a TSV block, then compare the complete A1-derived rectangle through htmlview. MEASURED BOUNDARY (2026-07-12): clipboard acceptance can occur without a durable write, so do not claim success unless verified is true and an independent sheets.read agrees.

gid.description: The numeric grid id from the URL #gid=<n>; first tab is 0.

anchor_cell.description: A1-style top-left anchor cell. Defaults to A1.

tsv.description: The block to paste: TAB (\t) between columns, NEWLINE (\n) between rows.

tools.name: sheets.cell.set
tools.description: Attempt to set one exact cell through the Name Box using trusted Enter events, then read htmlview before and after and require that exact A1 cell to equal the request. MEASURED BOUNDARY (2026-07-12): the current focus sequence can misaddress a write, so do not claim success unless verified is true and an independent sheets.read agrees.

cell_ref.description: A1-style cell reference to write into (e.g. 'B2').

value.description: The value to type into the cell.

workflow.output: {% ( $parse := function($b) { ( $table := $substringBefore($substringAfter($b, ''); $body := $substringAfter($table, ''); $rowFrags := [$filter($split($body, ' 0 })]; [$map($rowFrags, function($rf) { ( $cellFrags := [$filter($split($rf, ' 0 })]; [$map($cellFrags, function($cf) { $trim($replace($substringBefore($substringAfter($cf, '>'), ''), /<[^>]*>/, '')) })] ) })] ) }; $coord := $uppercase(input.cell_ref); $letters := $replace($coord, /[0-9]+/, ''); $row := $number($replace($coord, /[A-Z]+/, '')) - 1; $col := $reduce($split($letters, ''), function($a, $c) { $a * 26 + $length($substringBefore('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ', $c)) + 1 }, 0) - 1; $beforeRows := $parse(steps.fetchBefore.output.body); $afterRows := $parse(steps.verifyFetch.output.body); $beforeRow := $beforeRows[$row]; $afterRow := $afterRows[$row]; $before := $beforeRow[$col]; $after := $afterRow[$col]; $verified := steps.verifyFetch.output.status = 200 and $after = input.value and ($not($exists($before)) or $before != input.value); { 'cell_set': $coord, 'requested_value': input.value, 'before_value': $before, 'after_value': $after, 'verified': $verified, 'fetch_status': steps.verifyFetch.output.status, 'next_step': $verified ? 'Exact cell verified through htmlview; independently confirm with sheets.read.' : 'Exact cell did not verify. Do not claim success or retry blindly; read current grid state.' } ) %}
